claims.text: ThinkPrune trains long-thinking LLMs with RL under a strict token limit (over-limit output discarded before reward computation, reward 0 even if correct), iteratively tightening the limit across rounds (4k→3k) with checkpoint selection at ≤10% relative pass@1 drop on AIME22/23.
claims.context: Body-consumed method (§3.3, §5-equivalent implementation details: Verl framework, batch 128, 16 rollouts, GRPO).

claims.text: Body results table (R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B): accuracy preserved across budgets (MATH500 ~83, AIME24 27-29, AMC ~72, OlympiadBench ~45-46, avg ~57) while generation length roughly halves (AIME24 15484→6389-8301; avg 10355→~4940-5232). Eval protocol: temp 0.6, top-p 0.95, N=64 (AIME/AMC) / N=16 (MATH/OlympiadBench), max 32768, Qwen2.5-Math harness.
claims.context: Body-consumed results table + eval config; benchmark- and student-bound.

claims.text: ThinkPrune is a trainable TTC method (learned policy, not heuristic cutoff) in the test-time-compute taxonomy.
